expected_critiques.summary: Strength: links the falling run times, 1x and 2x spectra, iron and silicon in the oil and the 2019 SP-14 history, and also covers a bent column shaft and the rising P-4101B vibration.
Strength: four phases cover every technical requirement, including laser alignment, soft foot, teardown and an ISO/IEC 17025 metallurgical lab.
Strength: final report 10 weeks after award, three people offshore for 8 days, and P-4101B checks in 3-hour windows, all within the RFP constraints.
Clarification: compliance with the offline data rule is claimed through an Annex C data plan that is not part of the submitted document.

evidence.quote: We will test these hypotheses and look for others, including a bent column shaft and base plate distortion
Final report 10 weeks after award, two weeks inside the 12-week limit.
Three people offshore for 8 days, within the bed space constraint. P-4101B checks are split into 3-hour windows.
Full offshore HSE plan in Annex B. All site staff hold valid offshore survival certificates.
Offshore bed space is limited to three people for at most 10 days.

expected_critiques.summary: Missing requirement: metallurgical analysis is excluded and offered only as a later variation.
Weakness: CVs are only available on request, although the RFP requires CVs of key staff and two references.
Weakness: about 3 months depending on logistics is vague and does not commit to the 12-week limit in M3.
Weakness: assumes misalignment as the likely cause and does not address the rising vibration of standby pump P-4101B.
Missing requirement: refers to a standard HSE plan and defers staff certificates instead of providing them.
Missing requirement: no compliance matrix against the RFP.

expected_critiques.summary: Disqualifying: offers to upload platform vibration data to the bidder's cloud analytics portal, which breaks the offline data rule.
Weakness: assumes the pump is worn out and skips the requested failure analysis.
Missing requirement: proposes pump replacement instead of vibration, alignment, teardown and metallurgical analysis.
Weakness: lead time is not confirmed and no report date is given.
Weakness: USD 120,000 for a new pump set with installation extra, which does not buy the requested study.
